name: John Cobb
features: fair skin, thinning dark hair, small deep-set eyes, heavy jowled face, thick neck, big burly build, stolid unsmiling expression
bio: A quiet, enormous fur broker from Lloyd's who was the fastest man on earth three times over. Cobb's 24-litre Napier-Railton took the outright Brooklands lap record at 143.44 mph in October 1935 and nobody ever beat it. He raised the Land Speed Record at Bonneville in 1938, 1939 and again in 1947 at 394.19 mph. He was killed on Loch Ness in September 1952 when his jet boat Crusader disintegrated above 200 mph.
